marks_structure.passing_marks_theory: Theory mein 33% = approximately 27 marks laane zaroori hain. RBSE pass criteria 33% hai.
marks_structure.extra_time_note: 3 ghante 15 minute. 10 minute internal revision time extra. 250-word essays aur long answers ke liye time management zaroori.

paper_overview.sets_note: RBSE mein multiple sets hote hain. 2025 mein code SS-13-Hist. booklet 7009. Har set mein same questions, order alag.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi ya English dono allowed. Paper bilingual aata hai. Hindi-English mein conflict ho toh Hindi version official maana jayega.
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Internal choice (OR / Athva) Q14-Q17 (LA), Q18-Q19 (Essay), aur Q20 (Map) mein milta hai — kul 7 questions mein choice.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: RBSE History Class 12 ka syllabus NCERT 'Themes in Indian History' Part I, II, III par based hai — 15 chapters. SP Examination Idea Itihaas (Science Publications, Jaipur) bhi prepare karo.

question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 12 History mein 7 types ke questions: MCQ (1), Fill (1), VSA (1), SA (2), LA (3), Essay (4), Map (5). Total = 80 marks, 20 questions.

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf option (A/B/C/D ya अ/ब/स/द) likhna. Question number + option likhna zaroori.
types.mostly_from: Travelers + country match, ruler names, dynasties, dates, Sanchi patronage, Sufi titles, Vijayanagara dynasties, Ain-i-Akbari books, Akbar's land types, governors-general, Constituent Assembly members.

types.how_to_attempt: Ek shabd, naam ya saal likhna. Spelling correct zaroori.
types.mostly_from: Specific names (Al-Biruni birth year, Amara-nayaka system empire, traveler names, crops grown in Deccan).

types.how_to_attempt: Ek line mein factual answer. Definition/naam/karan/saal — seedhe point mein.
types.mostly_from: Harappan sites, Ashoka's titles, saguna bhakti definition, Khud-kashta meaning, Permanent settlement features, constitution assembly formation.
types.word_limit: Lagbhag 10 shabd (ek vakya ya ek line)

types.how_to_attempt: Concept + 2-3 points + example ya date. 1+1=2 format mein 'do visheshtayen' type questions. Concept clearly likho.
types.mostly_from: Harappan crafts, 6th century BCE events, Gotra meaning, Ibn Battuta on Delhi, Qawwali, Mahanavami Dibba, Jotedar vs Ryot, Direct Action Day, Jhansi ki Rani, 'historical vs synchronic' accounts.

types.how_to_attempt: Introduction (½) + main points 3-4 (2) + conclusion/example (½). OR option dekhkar easier wala choose karo.
types.mostly_from: Harappan script enigma, Sufism growth, 1857 Awadh revolt, Constitution-making language debate.

types.how_to_attempt: Introduction (½) + 4-5 main arguments with examples (3) + conclusion with opinion (½). Paragraph format mein likho.
types.mostly_from: Gandhi — Salt March significance, Rowlatt Satyagraha; Jain philosophy teachings; Stupa discovery history; Partition analysis; Bernier's comparison of East-West.

types.how_to_attempt: India outline map question paper ke saath milta hai. Pehle pencil se halka mark, phir blue pen se naam. Dot + arrow + naam = neat. Answer-book ke saath nathhi karna compulsory.
mostly_from: Harappan sites: Harappa, Mohenjodaro, Dholavira, Lothal, Kalibangan, Banawali
Mahajanapada capitals: Koshala (Shravasti), Magadha (Rajgir/Pataliputra), Avanti (Ujjain), Vatsa (Kaushambi)
Buddhist sites: Lumbini, Bodhgaya, Sarnath, Kusinagara, Sanchi, Amaravati
Mauryan inscriptions: Pataliputra, Girnar, Dhauli, Kandahar
Mughal cities: Delhi, Agra, Fatehpur Sikri, Lahore, Aurangabad
Colonial cities: Calcutta, Madras, Bombay, Surat
1857 revolt centres: Meerut, Delhi, Lucknow, Kanpur, Jhansi, Gwalior

paper_pattern.note: RBSE History theory paper = 80 marks. 4 sections + map question. 20 questions. Duration: 3 hours 15 minutes + 10 min revision. Bilingual (Hindi+English).
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Internal choice (OR / Athva) Q14-Q17 (LA), Q18-Q19 (Essay), aur Q20 (Map) mein milta hai — kul 7 questions mein choice.

chapters.name: Bricks, Beads and Bones — Harappan Civilization
topics: Sindhu Ghati sabhyata (Harappan) — 2600-1900 BCE approximately
Pramukh sthaan: Harappa, Mohenjodaro, Dholavira, Lothal, Kalibangan, Banawali, Rakhigarhi
Urban planning — citadel + lower town, grid pattern, Great Bath, granaries, drainage system
Shilp karya (crafts): Manke banana (bead-making), shankh ki kataai, dhatukarma, mohar nirman, baant (weights), textile
Sindhu lipi (script): Pictographic (chitramay), right-to-left, 375-400 signs, abhi tak padhi nahi gayi
Seals — Pashupati seal, unicorn seals, steatite material
Harappan puratatva ke janak: Sir John Marshall, R.D. Banerjee, Dayaram Sahni
Harappa excavation: 1921 (Dayaram Sahni)
Mohenjodaro excavation: 1922 (R.D. Banerjee)
Civilization decline: Climate change, Saraswati river drying, Aryan invasion theory (disputed)

chapters.name: Kings, Farmers and Towns — Early States and Economies (Mauryas, Ashoka)
topics: Mahajanapad kaal — 6th century BCE, 16 mahajanpad
Pramukh mahajanpad: Magadha, Koshala, Vatsa, Avanti, Gandhara
Magadha ka uday (rise) — Bimbisara, Ajatashatru, Mahapadmananda, Chandragupta Maurya
Maurya samrajya — Chandragupta Maurya (321 BCE) ne sthapana
Ashoka (268-232 BCE) — Kalinga war (261 BCE) ke baad Buddhism adopt
Ashoka ki upadhiyan: 'Piyadassi' aur 'Devanampiya'
Ashoka ke abhilekh (inscriptions): Prakrit bhasha, Brahmi lipi (mostly), Kharosthi (NW), Greek-Aramaic (Kandahar)
Pehla samrat jisne apni praja ke liye natural rocks + polished pillars par sandesh likhwaye: Ashoka
Ashok ka Dhamma: Badon ka aadar, doosron ke dharmon ka aadar, Brahmanon ka aadar, daason ke prati achha vyavahar
Kautilya (Chanakya) ka Arthashastra — Maurya administration
Janpadon mein jansankhya — first census attempt 1872 AD (brittish period)
Abhilekh (inscription) ka arth: patthar, dhatu ya mitti ke bartan par khude lekh

chapters.name: Kinship, Caste and Class — The Mahabharata
topics: Mahabharata — Itihaas shreni mein rakha gaya hai (Sanskrit parampara)
Mahabharata ka critical edition project — V.S. Sukthankar ne 1919 mein shuru kiya
Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute, Pune mein 47 saal mein poora (1966)
1,300+ manuscripts se compile
Kul vs Jati — Sanskrit granthon mein 'Kul' = parivar ke liye, 'Jati' = sage sambandhion ka bada samuh
Gotra — common ancestor se utpann vansh (patrilineal)
Varna vyavastha — Brahman, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra
Dharma sutras aur Dharma shastras mein varna aadarsh jeevika varnit:
- Brahman: Vedon ka pathan-pathan, yagya karna-karwana, daan lena-dena
- Kshatriya: Yuddh karna, suraksha karna, nyaya karna, yagya karna
- Vaishya: Ved padhna, yagya karna, daan-dakshina dena, gopalan, krishi-vyapar
- Shudra: Anya teen varnon ki seva karna
Manusmriti — Stri ke 'kartavyon' ki soochi milti hai
Matriliny vs Patriliny — kinship systems
Caste system still exists today (answer mein likhna zaroori hai jab asked)

chapters.name: Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings — Buddhism, Jainism, Sanchi
topics: Mahatma Buddha (563-483 BCE) — Siddhartha Gautam ka bachpan ka naam
Pramukh sthaan: Lumbini (janam), Bodhgaya (gyan prapti), Sarnath (pratham updesh — Dharmachakra Pravartan), Kusinagar (nibban/mahaparinirvan)
Buddha ki mrityu ke baad bhi tezi se failna — Sangha (Buddhist monastic order) ki wajah se
Pali bhasha — pracheen Buddhist granth Pali mein hain
Tripitaka — Buddhist canonical texts: Sutta Pitaka, Vinaya Pitaka, Abhidhamma Pitaka
Bheri Gatha Buddhist granth — Sutta Pitaka ka hissa
Buddhist sampradaay: Hinayana (original, no Buddha idol worship) aur Mahayana (new form, Buddha's idols worshipped)
Mahayana ki antim roop mein: Bodhisattva concept, Buddha divine figure
Stupa — Buddhist relics/remains ke upar banaya gaya dome structure
Pramukh stupas: Sanchi, Bharhut, Amaravati, Nagarjunakonda, Bodhgaya
Sanchi stupa — Ashoka ne banvaaya, later enlarged. Bhopal nawaab Shahjehan Begum aur Sultan Jehan Begum ne preservation ke liye dhan diya
Stupaon ki khoj — Europeans ne 19th century mein
Jain darshan — Mahavira ki shikshayen: Ahimsa, Satya, Asteya, Brahmacharya, Aparigraha (Panch-mahavrat)
Anekantavada, Syadvada — Jain philosophical concepts
Devi pooja ka prakar — Tantrik paddhati (Tantric)

chapters.name: Agrarian Relations — The Ain-i-Akbari
topics: Ain-i-Akbari — Abul Fazl dwara likhi, Akbar ke shasan ka vistrit vivran
Uddeshya: Samrajya ka poora khakha pesh karna
Ain ke 5 books (daftar):
1. Manzil-abadi: Imperial household
2. Sipah-abadi: Military and civil administration (sainik v naagarik prashasan)
3. Mulk-abadi: Fiscal details, provinces (suba-wise info)
4. Fourth book: Religion, literature, Hindu culture
5. Fifth book: Akbar's sayings, dynasty history
Akbar ke jameen ke prakar (land types):
- Polaj: Niyamit kheti hoti thi (regular cultivation)
- Parauti: Kuch waqt ke liye khali rakhi jati
- Chachar: 3-4 saal se khali
- Banjar: 5+ saal se nahin joti gayi (kisi bhi question mein aata hai)
Deccan pathar aur Madhya Bharat mein: Cotton (kapas), Dakhan mein large swathes
Irrigation ke kritrim sadhan: Nahar (canal), Kuan (well), Rahat, Dhenkli
Shah Nahar — Punjab mein built/repaired
Kisan, dastkaar ke beech fark mushkil (fluid distinction) — Mughal village society
Panchayat — mukhiya, krishi mein mahilaon ka role
Mughal kaal mein vazan + jamin measurement systems
Itmarari bandobast (permanent settlement) — post-Mughal colonial (1793)

chapters.name: Bhakti-Sufi Traditions — Changes in Religious Beliefs
topics: Bhakti andolan — personal devotion to god, 8th-18th century
Shankaracharya — Bhakti andolan ke janak mane jaate hain (textbook claim). Advaita vedanta
Ramanujacharya — Vishishtadvaita
Madhvacharya — Dvaita
Nirguna Bhakti — Formless god (Kabir, Nanak, Ravidas)
Saguna Bhakti — God with form/attributes (Mirabai, Tulsidas, Surdas, Chaitanya)
Alvars and Nayanars — Tamil Nadu's earliest Bhakti saints (6th-9th century)
Alvars: Vaishnava saints
Nayanars: Shaiva saints
Virashaivism (Lingayats) — Basavanna, 12th century Karnataka
Sufism — Islamic mysticism, tariqa (path)
Sufi silsilas: Chishti, Suhrawardi, Qadiri, Naqshbandi
Chishti silsila sabse popular — Muinuddin Chishti (Ajmer) 'Gharib Nawaz'
Nizamuddin Auliya — Delhi
Fariduddin Ganj-i-Shakar (Baba Farid)
Qawwali — Chishti upasana (Sama) ke sandarbh mein — sangeetmay devotional poetry
Khanqah — Sufi hostel/center
Dargah — Sufi saint's tomb
Ibn Battuta ne Delhi ke Chishti khanqahs ka varnan kiya
Hindu-Muslim sanskritik prabhav, jati-virodh, sant parampara

chapters.name: An Imperial Capital — Vijayanagara (Hampi)
topics: Vijayanagara samrajya — 1336 mein Harihara aur Bukka ne sthapit kiya
Raj-vanshay (dynasties): Sangama, Saluva, Tuluva, Aravidu
Krishnadeva Raya — Tuluva vansh ka prasiddh shasak (1509-1529)
Krishnadeva Raya ne 'Amuktamalyada' Telugu bhasha mein likhi
Vijayanagara ke shasak ko 'Raya' kaha jata tha
'Nayak' — sena ka pramukh, kile par niyantran
Amara-nayaka system — Vijayanagara ki pramukh rajnaitik khoj (innovation). Military chiefs ko land grants ke saath fiscal/military duties
Hampi — Vijayanagara ki rajdhani (Karnataka, Tungabhadra river ke paas)
Pramukh bhavan: Lotus Mahal, Virupaksha Temple, Vitthala Temple, Hazara Rama Temple, Mahanavami Dibba, Elephant Stables
Mahanavami Dibba — Mahanavami festival ka raj-manch. Shahi anusthan (royal rituals) — pooja, sena ka nirikshan, wrestling, procession
Lotus Mahal — royal centre ka sundar bhavan (palace)
Rakshasi-Tangadi (Talikota) yuddh — 1565, Deccan Sultanates ne Vijayanagara ko haraya
Ye yuddh ke baad Vijayanagara barbaad ho gaya

chapters.name: Peasants, Zamindars and the State — Mughal Court
topics: Mughal samrajya — paternally from Timur (Turkic), maternally from Chengiz Khan (Mongol)
Mughal ka matrubhasha: Turki (not Persian)
'Mughal' shabd 'Mongol' se vyutpann hua
Babur (1526) — Mughal empire founder, defeated Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat
Akbar (1556-1605) — centralization, Mansabdari, Din-i-Ilahi
Mansabdari system — rank-based military administration. Zat + Sawar
Jagirdari system — revenue assignment for salary
Zamindar — local landholder, revenue collector, military service
Kisan (peasant) categories: Khud-kashta (resident cultivators, owned land), Pahi-kashta (non-resident, tenant farmers)
Village panchayat — mukhiya (headman), caste panchayats, internal disputes resolution
Mughal court — Jharokha darshan, diwan-i-am, diwan-i-khas, rituals
Ain-i-Akbari — Mughal administration source
Agricultural diversity — mon crops, cash crops, irrigation
Women in agriculture — weeding, transplanting, harvesting

chapters.name: Through the Eyes of Travellers — Perceptions of Society
topics: Pramukh videshi yatri (foreign travellers):
Al-Biruni — 11th century, Arab/Persian, Mahmud Ghazni ke saath aya. Janam 973 AD, Khwarizm (Uzbekistan)
Al-Biruni ka granth: 'Kitab-ul-Hind' (Tahqiq-i-Hind) — Arabic bhasha mein
Ibn Battuta — 14th century, Morocco ka. Muhammad bin Tughlaq ne Delhi ka Qazi niyukt kiya
Ibn Battuta ka granth: 'Rihla' — Arabic bhasha
Ibn Battuta ne Delhi ki visheshtayen batayi: vishal shahar, sundar mahal, darbar, bazaars, dharmic vividhata
Nicolo Conti — 15th century Italian
Abdur Razzaq — 15th century Persian doot (ambassador) — 'Piyadassi' pariplu
Francois Bernier — 17th century French doctor (Aurangzeb era)
Bernier India mein 12 saal tak raha
Bernier's book: 'Travels in the Mughal Empire'
Bernier ne 'Purva aur Paschim' ki tulna ki — India ko European countries se compare kiya
Bernier's criticism: No private land ownership in India, poor cities, crown ownership
Jean-Baptiste Tavernier — French traveller, diamond trader
Comparison Al-Biruni vs Ibn Battuta: Dono Arabic, dono social life describe kiya, dono high-level scholars

chapters.name: Colonialism and the Countryside — Rural Society
topics: East India Company ki bhumika — commerce se conquest tak
Permanent Settlement (Istmarari Bandobast) — 1793, Lord Cornwallis, Bengal-Bihar-Orissa
Zamindari system — zamindar fixed revenue dete the Company ko
Permanent Settlement ki visheshta: Fixed revenue, hereditary zamindari, sunset clause (default = land auction)
Ryotwari system — Madras, Bombay presidency mein. Direct settlement with cultivators
Mahalwari system — North India. Village-based settlement
Jotedar — rich peasants jo zamindari system mein upadhyay (middlemen) ban gaye, gaon mein real power
Ryot — peasant cultivator, jotedar se tenancy lete the
Paharia (hill people) — Rajmahal hills, tribal
Santhal — Damin-i-Koh region, settled agriculturalists became
Buchanan — 19th century early mein Rajmahal hills ka dora kiya, survey kiya
Paanchvi Report (Fifth Report) — British Parliament ko 1813 mein pesh ki gayi. East India Company ke administration/revenue ka detailed survey
Deccan Riots 1875 — moneylenders ke khilaf
Moneylenders' records, bonds, debts
Zamindar's strategies to retain land: Fake auctions (own men bid high), partition among family, violent resistance

chapters.name: Rebels and the Raj — 1857 Revolt
topics: 1857 revolt — 'Pehli Swatantrata Sangram', 'Sepoy Mutiny'
Karan: Doctrine of Lapse (Dalhousie), annexation policies, Enfield rifle cartridge controversy, economic exploitation, religious hurt
Awadh annexation — 1856, Dalhousie (1851 mein GG)
Dalhousie ne kaha tha 'Ye gilaas phal ek din hamaare hi munh mein aakar girenga' — Awadh ke baare mein (Doctrine of Lapse kaam karegi)
1801 mein Awadh mein Sahayak Sandhi thopi gayi. Nawab angrezon par nirbhar ho gaya. Resident ki salah se kaam.
1857 Revolt start: 29 March 1857 (Mangal Pandey at Barrackpore), May 10 Meerut
Pramukh kendra: Delhi (Bahadur Shah Zafar), Lucknow (Begum Hazrat Mahal, Birjis Qadr), Kanpur (Nana Sahib), Jhansi (Rani Lakshmibai), Bihar (Kunwar Singh)
Rani of Jhansi — Manikarnika, Lakshmibai, 1828-1858, Gangadhar Rao ki patni, Doctrine of Lapse ke wajah se biren-less state annexed
Bhajan ki rani ko rebellion leadership uthana pada when Jhansi annexed + adopted son refused recognition
1857 British response: Brutal repression, Delhi recapture (September 1857), Bahadur Shah deposed
1858 — Queen's Proclamation, East India Company ka end, direct Crown rule
1857 visualizations — British pictures show 'justice' and restoration; Indian oral traditions show heroism
Felice Beato — photographer who shot ruins of Lucknow Residency

chapters.name: Colonial Cities — Urbanisation, Planning and Architecture
topics: Colonial shahar: Calcutta (Kolkata), Madras (Chennai), Bombay (Mumbai)
1861 mein America mein Civil War shuru — Indian cotton demand badhi — Bombay prosperity
Colonial cities ke social features — aaj bhi dikhte hain:
1. Yaatayat ke sadhan ka vikas (transport)
2. Manoranjan v milne-julane ke naye sarvajanik sthal (public spaces)
3. Madhyam varg ka vistar (middle class growth)
4. Mahilaaon ki sthiti mein parivartan
5. Mehnatkash, garib ya kaamgaaron mein vriddhi (workers increase)
Municipal administration — 19th century
Racial segregation — White town vs Black town
Hill stations — Shimla, Darjeeling, Ooty (British summer capitals)
Railway expansion — 1853 first train (Bombay-Thane)
Census — 1872 first attempt, 1881 regular decennial
Shahar ki vastukala: Neo-classical, Gothic Revival, Indo-Saracenic
Ranigunj, Jharia — khanan (mining) towns
Cantonments (chhawniyan) — Ambala, garrison towns

chapters.name: Mahatma Gandhi and the Nationalist Movement
topics: Gandhi ka janm: 2 October 1869, Porbandar, Gujarat
South Africa mein 1893-1915 — Satyagraha technique develop. 'South Africa made the Mahatma'
Bharat vaapsi: 9 January 1915
Gopal Krishna Gokhale — Gandhi's political guru. Salah di: 1 saal poora Bharat ghoomo, logon ko jaano
Gandhi's mass movements:
1. Champaran Satyagraha 1917 — Indigo planters
2. Kheda Satyagraha 1918 — Peasant tax relief
3. Ahmedabad Mill Strike 1918 — Mill workers
4. Rowlatt Satyagraha 1919 — All-India protest against Rowlatt Act. 'Made Gandhi truly national leader'
5. Non-Cooperation Movement 1920-22 — called off after Chauri Chaura
6. Salt March / Dandi March 1930 — 12 March to 6 April, 240 miles. Civil Disobedience Movement
7. Quit India Movement 8 August 1942 — 'Karo ya Maro' (Do or Die)
Gandhi's tactical wisdom: Salt monopoly chosen because it affected everyone — masses could participate
Gandhi's simple attire: Dhoti, charkha (spinning wheel), Harijan welfare, 'India lives in villages'
Hindustani bhasha — Gandhi ki rashtriya bhasha banane ki ichchha. Hindi + Urdu = Hindustani. 'Har bharatiya samjhe'. But bhasha rajnaitik bindu ban gayi.
1946 calcutta riots — Gandhi Noakhali, Bihar dora
September 1947 — Gandhi Delhi mein anshan — 'Ab Dilli bach jaayegi' (Shahid Ahmad Dehlavi quote)
30 January 1948 — Gandhi's assassination by Nathuram Godse at Birla House

chapters.name: Understanding Partition — Politics, Memories, Experiences
topics: Vibhajan ke karan:
1. 1909 Act — Angrezon ne 'phoot' (communal divide) pehli baar legal structure mein laya
2. Prithak chunav (separate electorates) ke parinaam
3. 1940 Lahore Resolution — Muslim League ne Pakistan demand ki
4. 1946 Direct Action Day — 16 August, Calcutta killings
5. Sampradayik zahar failne ki wajah se 1947 mein ntwara
6. Angrezon ki divide-and-rule policy
Mountbatten Plan — 3 June 1947 — partition announcement
15 August 1947 — Independence + Partition
Radcliffe Line — drawn by Cyril Radcliffe (5 weeks only, never been to India before)
Punjab aur Bengal — main bata. Partition violence — lakhs killed, 1 crore+ refugees
Oral sources — partition survivors' memoirs, interviews — history re-written
Mahila experiences: Abduction, rape, 'honor killings'
Urvashi Butalia's 'The Other Side of Silence' — oral history
Gandhi's role in partition — anshan, Noakhali walk, Delhi peace efforts
'India ka banawara ek sampradayic rajneeti ka aakhri bindu tha' — debate topic
Post-partition: Recovery of abducted women, rehabilitation, Kashmir issue (1947-48)

chapters.name: Framing the Constitution — The Beginning of a New Era
topics: Constituent Assembly — formed from Cabinet Mission Plan 1946
Indirect election from provincial assemblies (Pradeshik Vidhan Sabhaon se)
First meeting: 9 December 1946
President (Adhyaksh): Dr. Rajendra Prasad
Drafting Committee chairman: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
B.R. Ambedkar invited to become Union Law Minister — Gandhi's advice
Total members: 389 initially, 299 after partition (actually 284 signed)
Sessions: 11 sessions, 165 days, over 2 years 11 months 18 days
Constitution adopted: 26 November 1949
Constitution came into force: 26 January 1950 (Republic Day)
K.M. Munshi — Gujarat se important member, Drafting Committee
Jawaharlal Nehru — Objectives Resolution (13 December 1946)
Federal structure — Kendra-Rajya shakti batwara 3 soochiyon mein:
1. Union List (Sangh Soochi) — Kendra ke vishay (defense, foreign affairs, railways)
2. State List (Rajya Soochi) — Rajyon ke vishay (police, agriculture, public health)
3. Concurrent List (Samavarti Soochi) — dono ke common vishay (education, forests)
Bhasha ka mudda — Constituent Assembly mein debate:
- Hindi vs Hindustani
- Regional languages
- English as link language
- Final: Hindi (Devanagari) as official language, English continued for 15 years, regional languages recognized in 8th Schedule
Mandatory Fundamental Rights + Directive Principles
Universal Adult Franchise — 21 years initially (lowered to 18 in 1989)

- Hindi vs Hindustani
- Regional languages
- English as link language
- Final: Hindi (Devanagari) as official language, English continued for 15 years, regional languages recognized in 8th Schedule

paper_objectives_weightage.note: Official blueprint ke hisaab se paper 4 objectives par banaya jaata hai. Understanding (avbodh) sabse bada component hai:

knowledge_Gyan.note: Facts, dates, naam, definitions — MCQ, Fill, VSA mein yaad-based

understanding_Avbodh.note: Concepts samjhana, tulna karna, vishleshan — SA aur LA mein MAXIMUM weightage. History ka core.

application_Gyanopyog.note: Knowledge ka application, 'aap kaise kah sakte hain' type — Essay aur LA mein

skill_Kaushal_Maulikta.note: Map work = guaranteed 5 marks skill component

important_formula_sheets.note: Not typically applicable for History (humanities subject).

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: Section A (MCQ + Fill + VSA) = 35 marks guaranteed scoring if basics clear. Essays aur LA mein understanding + application test hoti hai.
most_scoring_sections: Easy — 35 marks scope, facts/dates/names. 25-30 marks easily if prepared.
Easy-Medium — 50 words, concept + points. 15-18 marks achievable.

tips: 35 objective questions (MCQ + Fill + VSA) = 35 marks — sab attempt karo, no negative
Dates yaad karo — direct MCQ mein aate hain (1509 Krishnadeva, 1813 Fifth Report, 1793 Permanent Settlement)
Traveler + country + book list alag banao — 5-6 marks pakke
Essay mein Gandhi ka topic almost guaranteed — Salt March, Rowlatt, Quit India
Ain-i-Akbari Essay source chapter — 5 daftar + 4 land types yaad karo
Spelling important — Vijayanagara, Krishnadeva Raya, Khwarizm, Muinuddin, Mohenjodaro — gal spell se cut
Hindi-English conflict mein Hindi official — Hindi samjhau toh Hindi mein likho
Map attach karna zaroori — outline map answer book ke saath nathhi karo
Pencil pehle map par, phir blue pen — corrections allow karta hai
OR option dono padho, easier choose karo
Long answers mein dates aur names specifically likho — marker ke liye easy
Historical sources (Ain, Rihla, Bernier's travels) quote karo jahaan possible

time_allocation.note: 35 objective questions — MCQ 1.5 min, Fill 1 min, VSA 2 min. Total ~50 min. Confusion mein guess karo.
10 SA × 5 min. 50 shabd. Concept + 2 points + example.
4 LA × 10 min. 100 shabd. OR option choose wisely.
2 Essay × 20 min. 250 shabd. Intro + body + conclusion structure.
5 sthaan × 2 min. Pencil → pen. Neat marking.
Question numbers check, spelling verify, map attached confirm.

answer_sheet_rules: roll_number_on_paper: Question paper par pehle roll number likho (compulsory rule)
question_number_compulsory: Question number har answer se pehle likhna
internal_parts_together: Jis prashn mein parts hain (i, ii, iii), un sabhi ke answers ek saath likho
language_rule: Hindi ya English — consistent. Mixed bhi chalega par readable ho. Conflict mein Hindi official.
mcq_attempt_all: Sare 18 MCQ attempt karo — guess bhi karo
map_spelling: Map mein naam spelling galat = 0 marks for that point
essay_structure: Intro + body + conclusion — even partial structure gets marks

pen_rules.note: allowed_colors: ['Blue', 'Black'] pencil_use: Map work ke liye zaroori. Diagrams/timeline ke liye bhi helpful. map_marking: Pencil se location dot + naam halka, fir blue pen se neat. Arrow optional.

exam_writing_rules.diagram_rules: word_limits_approximate: 10/50/100/250 shabd approximate — 10-15% flexibility paragraph_format: SA, LA, Essay mein paragraph format. Points ko paragraph mein piro do. quotes_and_sources: Jahaan possible ho, historical quotes include karo (Ain, Rihla, inscriptions) spelling_important: Proper nouns — spelling sahi zaroori. Al-Biruni, Muinuddin, Krishnadeva Raya, Sukthankar, Mohenjodaro — galat spell = marks cut partial_marking: True partial_marking_note: Incomplete answer par bhi partial marks — kuch na kuch zaroor likho
